title: Uniform local mass bound for blow-ups with converging centres (supplied step 7, hypothesis (H4) of flat_limit)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), x ∈ ℝ^P, and let x_i ∈ ℝ^P and λ_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) satisfy x_i → x and λ_i → 0. Assume there are C ∈ ℝ and r₀ > 0 such that M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) ≤ ofReal(Cρ^n) (T.massOn (ball y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C·ρ^n)) for every y ∈ ball(x, r₀) and every ρ with 0 < ρ < r₀. Then for every R > 0 there is c ∈ ℝ such that, for all sufficiently large i, every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) with tsupport ω ⊆ ball(0, R) and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(y)) ≤ 1 for all y satisfies currentEval(η_{x_i,λ_i#}T)(ω) ≤ c. Here η_{x_i,λ_i#}T = blowUp T x_i λ_i ∈ 𝒟_n(η_{x_i,λ_i}(U)), and currentEval(S')(ω) is S'(ω) when ω is a test form with tsupport inside the domain of S', and 0 otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i), Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → (∃ C r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x r₀, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r₀ → T.massOn (ball y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ ball 0 R → (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y) ≤ 1) → currentEval (blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ≤ c
